title: 2002 HMMT February Guts Problem 50
statement: Give the set of all positive integers \(n\) such that \(\varphi(n)=2002^{2}-1\).

solutions.text: The empty set, \(\varnothing\). If \(m\) is relatively prime to \(n\) and \(m<n\), then \(n-m\) must likewise be relatively prime to \(n\), and these are distinct for \(n>2\) since \(n / 2, n\) are not relatively prime. Therefore, for all \(n>2, \varphi(n)\) must be even. \(2002^{2}-1\) is odd, and \(\varphi(2)=1 \neq 2002^{2}-1\), so no numbers \(n\) fulfill the equation.
